delete: Recovery depends on backups, trash or version control; untracked data may be lost.
history: Recovery may require reflogs or collaborators' clones. Shared-branch state is unknown.
data: Recovery depends on database backups or a tested reverse migration. Target environment is unknown.
install: Uninstalling or restoring configuration may be needed; scripts can have further effects.
system: System or privileged changes may require manual recovery.
publish: Published content may be copied; deletion cannot guarantee recall.
routine: Routine remote write; usually editable or revertible, but others may already have seen it.
credential: Credential access is observed, not proof of disclosure; exposure may require rotation.
process: Processes can be restarted; in-flight work may be lost.
permission: Restore the prior mode or owner; its previous value is not recorded.
spend: Provisioning or purchases can incur charges that cannot be undone.
outside_write: Recovery may require a previous file copy; the old contents are not recorded.
